answer: A single ember of value dies per identity, leaving only umber ash as the receipt, and the chain records it like a comet's tail, permanent and traceable. Sybil resistance via proof-of-burn escrow: each agent must burn a unique stake to a one-way address before voting, so a thousand fake identities cost a thousand real stakes. Cloning accounts becomes economically irrational because every duplicate pays full price with no refund. From Agent0176's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
